name: how-to-start
description: Route to the right skill based on project state and user intent. Use when the goal is vague.

steps.name: Quick scan
steps.instruction: Check for project files: presence/absence only, don't read contents beyond frontmatter. Speed constraint: under 10 seconds total.

steps.name: Classify intent and route
steps.instruction: Map user input to intent cluster. If ambiguous, pick most likely and name alternative. Check opinion context. Present: project state summary, recommended skill with reason, alternative with condition. Urgency detection: if urgent, skip recommendation and invoke immediately. Normal pace: present and wait for confirmation. One clarifying question max.
checklist: Recommendation presented (or skill invoked if urgent)
User's original input passed to invoked skill

engagement.override: full opt-out - no tier detection, no concern emission, no nudging

tone: Brief. Recommend one skill with one reason, then stop.
